title: Món này chưa được nấu chín kỹ
pronunciation: Mon nay chua duoc nau chin ky
summary: For sending back food that looks or feels not cooked through.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Point to the bite, bowl, or plate while the food is still in front of you.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say it calmly before eating more; if needed, ask them to change it or cook it longer.

phrases.vietnamese: Món này chưa được nấu chín kỹ
phrases.pronunciation: Mon nay chua duoc nau chin ky

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Món này means this dish; chưa được nấu chín kỹ means not cooked thoroughly yet.

breakdown.vietnamese: Món này chưa được nấu chín kỹ

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at restaurants, cafes, hotel breakfasts, and stalls where staff can still fix the dish.

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có vị hư hỏng
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co vi hu hong

phrases.vietnamese: Có thứ gì đó trong thức ăn của tôi
phrases.english: There is something in my food
phrases.pronunciation: Co thu gi do trong thuc an cua toi

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi yêu cầu món này không cay.
phrases.english: I asked for this not spicy.
phrases.pronunciation: Toi yeu cau mon nay khong cay

phrases.vietnamese: Món này quá cay đối với tôi.
phrases.english: This is too spicy for me.
phrases.pronunciation: Mon nay qua cay doi voi toi

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Keep the plate visible and avoid a long explanation. A clear point is usually enough.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Change-this, cold-food, spoiled-food, something-in-food, and too-spicy pages cover nearby food problems.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể thay đổi điều này?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the thay doi dieu nay

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Cold, spoiled, and something-in-food phrases help if the issue is safety or quality, not doneness.
